cases.summary: Fix rooting of external array buffer pointer
cases.description:
I think there is one thing that we, and the previous code, missed, which is immediate rooting of [the pointer returned by `NewExternalArrayBuffer` ](https://github.com/servo/servo/pull/31202/files#diff-8f10f5d3caee3cce7befe080a3333a5f9402a651884287734f41e786e4323181R186). 

GC can happen, even though it appears like it couldn't, for example if it occurs in response to a timer in another SpiderMonkey GC thread, see second part of https://github.com/mozilla-spidermonkey/spidermonkey-embedding-examples/blob/esr78/docs/GC%20Rooting%20Guide.md#performance-tweaking

See gecko: https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/9bb5d5f55da6cc7163dd93825c25609b769822f9/dom/webgpu/Buffer.cpp#291

We should fix this like: `rooted!(in(cx) let object = NewExternalArrayBuffer(..))`.

evidence.eventual_fix_diff:
commit a4db81cbd041a9470f0997b3ac736abe034bccdb
Author: Taym Haddadi <haddadi.taym@gmail.com>
Date:   Wed Feb 14 03:34:05 2024 +0100

    Fix rooting of external array buffer pointer (#31342)
    
    Signed-off-by: Bentaimia Haddadi <haddadi.taym@gmail.com>

diff --git a/components/script/dom/bindings/typedarrays.rs b/components/script/dom/bindings/typedarrays.rs
index c5582ccc5f3..bc49c4678c1 100644
--- a/components/script/dom/bindings/typedarrays.rs
+++ b/components/script/dom/bindings/typedarrays.rs
@@ -183,16 +183,18 @@ where
         let mapping_slice_ptr =
             mapping.lock().unwrap().borrow_mut()[offset as usize..m_end as usize].as_mut_ptr();
 
-        let array_buffer = NewExternalArrayBuffer(
+        // rooted! is needed to ensure memory safety and prevent potential garbage collection issues.
+        // https://github.com/mozilla-spidermonkey/spidermonkey-embedding-examples/blob/esr78/docs/GC%20Rooting%20Guide.md#performance-tweaking
+        rooted!(in(*cx) let array_buffer = NewExternalArrayBuffer(
             *cx,
             range_size as usize,
             mapping_slice_ptr as _,
             Some(free_func),
             Arc::into_raw(mapping) as _,
-        );
+        ));
 
         HeapTypedArray {
-            internal: Heap::boxed(array_buffer),
+            internal: Heap::boxed(*array_buffer),
             phantom: PhantomData::default(),
         }
     }
